besluite.rede: 'hierdie roetes' points clearly enough to the inland-to-coast journey just described; 'daarheen' is a lateral move that also narrows the routes to one direction.
'vra' in the sense of 'demands' is idiomatic Afrikaans, so the original reads well and the rewrite is only different.

besluite.fout: 'in dieselfde veld as die pad' is a stiff comparison construction
besluite.rede: The rewrite says the same thing naturally, matches the past tense of the other list items, and adds only one word.

besluite.fout: water itself cannot be 'far apart'; the places where it was found were
besluite.rede: 'Waterplekke' fixes the logical slip without changing what the item says.
The original reads naturally as far from the help at home, while the proposal widens it to far from any help, which moves the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'reisigers' is repeated woodenly from the sentence directly before
besluite.rede: 'hulle' can only refer to the travellers in the previous sentence, and the protected wording is untouched.

besluite.fout: the prepositional phrase after 'volg' is a slightly less natural order in the relative clause
besluite.rede: This is a word-order improvement to a glossary definition rather than a plain grammar error, so the writer has to make it for every lesson at once.
